title: Syrex's Advanced Chat Mod
description: For this minecraft mod 1.21.10 - 1.21.11 we will be able to talk in advanced chat we can write voice messages and files and messages and the server also does not keep logs on the server
body:
# 🌐 Syrex P2P Chat & Media Share

[TR] %100 Client-Side (İstemci taraflı) çalışan, sunucuda eklenti gerektirmeyen gelişmiş P2P sohbet ve dosya paylaşım modu.
[EN] A 100% Client-Side advanced P2P chat and file sharing mod that requires no server-side plugins.

---

## ✨ Özellikler / Features

* **⚡ Client-Side P2P:** Sunucudan bağımsız, doğrudan oyuncular arası güvenli bağlantı. / No server plugins required. Direct peer-to-peer connection.
* **📂 Media & File Share:** `.jar`, `.zip`, `.png`/`.jpg` dosyalarını sohbetten gönderin. / Share mods, zip files, and images directly through chat.
* **🎙️ Voice Messages:** Oyun içinden ses kaydı alıp gönderin ve dinleyin. / Record, send, and play voice notes in-game.
* **🖥️ Custom UI:** Standart sohbetten bağımsız, `H` tuşu ile açılan özel arayüz. / A modern custom GUI opened with the `H` key.
* **🔒 Isolated:** Sunucu komutları çalışmaz, sohbet loglara düşmez. / Secure chat, isolated from server commands and logs.

---

## 🛠️ Teknik Detaylar / Technical Details

* **Versions:** Minecraft 1.21.10 - 1.21.11
* **Platform:** Fabric Loader
* **Performance:** %100 Asynchronous / Async threads for 0% FPS drop.

---

## 🚀 Kullanım / Usage

1. Put the mod into your `mods` folder.
2. Press **`H`** in-game to open the custom **Syrex UI**.
3. Select a friend and start chatting, sharing files, or sending voice notes!

---
